hero.eyebrow: From the founder, for first-time sauna buyers
hero.headline: Sauna shopping should not be this confusing
hero.subhead: Heat, red light and a clear price, so you can relax at home without the guesswork.

reasons.headline: Heat that reaches your whole body
reasons.body: Heaters sit all around you, so the warmth gets to your back, sides and legs. The cabin heats up to 150°F with near, mid and far infrared.

reasons.headline: Red light comes with every cabin
reasons.body: Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard. You sit about seven to eight inches from the panel while the cabin warms.

reasons.headline: At your door in days
reasons.body: Every order ships free. In-stock orders leave the warehouse in a few business days, and the freight comes on a delivery day you set.

reasons.headline: Fits a spare corner of the house
reasons.body: Two people sit side by side in Canadian red cedar. Built, the cabin is 53 inches wide and 44 inches deep. It runs on a 120V / 20A dedicated outlet.

questions.question: Do I need special wiring?
questions.answer: You need a 120V / 20A dedicated outlet. A standard 15A outlet is not sufficient, so check your panel before ordering.

questions.question: How many people fit inside?
questions.answer: Two people sit side by side on one bench.

questions.question: How hot does the cabin get?
questions.answer: The Fuji reaches up to 150°F, with heaters placed around you so the warmth reaches your back, sides and legs, not just the front.

questions.question: Does red light come with it?
questions.answer: Yes. Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard, with one panel you face from about seven to eight inches away.

closing.headline: See the Fuji and its price up close
